review_candidates.title: Project Manager – Water Instrumentation, SCADA & Smart Irrigation
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key responsibilities • Take over the project's technical files: PLC programs, SCADA application, backups, licenses, I/O lists, network settings, and drawings. • Set up and troubleshoot communication between remote sites and the control room (Modbus, Profinet, GSM/4G, VPN). Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Control, Communications, or Mechatronics Engineering, or an equivalent field. • 4+ years of hands-on experience in PLC and SCADA projects, from installation to commissioning.
eligibility_evidence: We deliver projects for water utilities, government bodies, international organizations, and private farms across Egypt.

About the role We are hiring a Project Engineer to take technical ownership of an ongoing flow and pressure instrumentation and SCADA project for a water utility, and lead it on site through commissioning and handover.
• Supervise technicians and subcontractors on site, and report progress weekly.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Control, Communications, or Mechatronics Engineering, or an equivalent field. • 4+ years of hands-on experience in PLC and SCADA projects, from installation to commissioning. • Professional working proficiency in Arabic and good technical English.
